0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The allergic Yok Huy is in need of a dry delivery.

24.original: Gather Larh Tortoh violets and defeat any threats that appear.

25.original: Deliver the Larh Tortoh violets to the allergic Yok Huy.

48.original: Ah, I know you! You are a member of the Third Promise's retinue, as I recall, and strong for your size besides.

49.original: I would ask a favor, then. Could you pick three Larh Tortoh violets and bring them to me?

50.original: The field's monstrous plants and their pollen are more than my nose can bear, and no one wants drippy flowers. At the very least, <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> do not.

51.original: I need three of those violets that grow in Larh Tortoh. You will fetch them for me, won't you? Please, spare my poor nose...

52.original: Welcome back! The picking went well, I take it?

53.original: Thank you for obliging me. I wanted to get flowers for my grandmother, and these are one of her favorites.

54.original: We have a tradition of carving symbols of our favorite things on our graves, you see. Hers has a flower for each of the four seasons, so I've been giving her a few of each throughout the year.

55.original: Well, I had better get these to Grandmother before they wilt. Take this as a token of my thanks!
